title: Reconciled
oneLiner: B2B reconciliation layer — fewer spreadsheets, clearer audit trails for finance teams.

problem.heading: Problem
problem.description: Finance ops lived in brittle spreadsheets and one-off scripts. Reconciliation runs were slow to audit and risky when key people were out — the org needed a single source of truth with exportable evidence.

myRole.heading: My role
myRole.description: Led full-stack delivery: schema design for immutable run logs, React dashboards for exception queues, and rollout playbooks for migrating legacy CSV pipelines.

solution.heading: Solution
solution.description: Introduced a Postgres-centric model with row-level audit, idempotent job workers, and a React surface for reviewers. Deprecated parallel scripts behind feature flags to reduce blast radius.

impact.heading: Impact
metrics: ~40% reduction in reported technical debt after consolidation sprint
Audit prep time cut from days to hours for pilot customers
Zero data-loss incidents across six months of production reconciliation volume
impact.description: Product was later acquired; metrics reflect pre-acquisition pilot program results shared with stakeholders.
